rounds.text: Texmo Pipes & Products Ltd is heavily under-appreciated because it trades at an exceptionally low price-to-book ratio of 0.56x, with the share price at ₹ 42.9 against a book value of ₹ 77.2 [E2]. This deep discount is further magnified when compared against sector benchmarks, where the company's P/E of 8.95x sits dramatically lower than the sector benchmark of 25.21x, and its P/B of 0.75x compares favorably to the sector benchmark of 2.23x [E6, E7]. The business is generating superior operational efficiency relative to its peers, delivering an ROA of 3.72% that outperforms the sector benchmark of -2.72%, alongside an ROCE of 8.82% beating the sector benchmark of 6.25% [E8, E10]. Moreover, the company has broken through its recent historical stagnation by delivering a positive sales growth of +5% YoY [E66]. conceded: [E14], [E15], [E16], [E17], [E26], [E27], [E28], [E29].
